I am an old woman, fifty years, and I work this small barley plot myself. Cash is short this season and one full bag of DAP is too much for such a small plot — I will buy a small share from a neighbor if the cooperative brings fertilizer in time, but only a little. I put the manure from my two oxen and few sheep on this plot like I always do, because that is what keeps my barley growing. I use my own barley seed that I saved from last harvest, like my mother taught me, and I weed with my daughter-in-law — we do not have money for sprays or hired hands, and there is no river near my plot to water it.
